dct_description_sm: The Coral Harbour Oceanographic Observation and Sea ice Experiments (CHOOSE) project brought together an international team of researchers to study the physical and biogeochemical properties of sea ice and waters near-to the community of Coral Harbour. Research objectives included, i) To characterize nutrients and carbon dynamics in and under the sea ice as a function of sub-ice turbulence and, ii) to evaluate the relationship between environmental conditions and ice associated microbial communities (production, composition, genomics & photophysiology). This project is part of ongoing projects lead by the University of Manitoba (Southampton Island Marine Ecosystem Project (SIMEP), Community-driven Sea Ice and Ocean Research in the Contrasting CoastalDomains of Hudson Bay (CCDHB)) and the University of Bristol, UK (Diatom Autecological Responses with Changes To Ice Cover (Diatom ARCTIC)). This PDC input includes data collected during the spring sea ice campaign 1 May - 7 June, 2019.
dct_title_s: The Coral Harbour Oceanographic Observation and Sea ice Experiments (CHOOSE) project  & CAO Diatom Autecological Responses to Changes in Ice Cover (Diatom ARCTIC)  2019
